title: Andon escalation rules
ruleNamePlaceholder: e.g. Equipment issue not responded in 15 minutes
scopeHelp: Rules with both type and severity win, then severity only, type only, and finally rules with neither
responseHelp: Handling must start within this time after reporting; escalates and notifies when exceeded
resolveHelp: Must be resolved within this time after reporting; not shorter than the response limit
limitRequired: Enter a response limit or a resolution limit
escalateHelp: Must be higher than the severity the rule applies to; leave empty to notify without escalating
notifyUsersPlaceholder: Filter by name or account, up to 20 people
notifyHelp: These people and the current handler are notified when a limit is exceeded; leave empty to notify the handler only
formHint: Each limit escalates and notifies only once. After saving, open andon events recalculate their deadlines with the new rules (within about a minute).
